blocks.html: Robinsons Malls is painting the town in pastels and setting free all the Easter bunnies as it holds exciting Easter celebrations in its various malls in Metro Manila. Cap the Holy Week right, by spending quality time with your kids and treating them to fun and interactive activities. Start off with the pre-Easter Art Workshops at Robinsons Magnolia on April 8 and 9 at the mall atrium. Hone their creativity with its free Paint Your Easter Bunny and Easter Cookie Decorating workshops. Just register your kids at the atrium at 2pm. Come Easter, April 16, Robinsons Magnolia will be transforming its atrium into a kiddie carnival composed of game booths such as Balloon Shot, Hoop Shot, life-size Snakes and Ladders, Sling Shot and Ball Drop complemented with free face painting. Children will definitely enjoy the amusing shows in store for them like the Juggling and Unicycling acts, Magic Show and Bubble Show, all happening at the mall atrium starting 1 pm. The Easter egg hunt will follow at 4 pm at the garden area. To join, shoppers simply need to present a P1,000 minimum purchase receipt made from April 15 to April 16. Registration starts on April 15, 10 am at the atrium. And if that’s not enough, Robinsons Magnolia will hold a Kiddie Cooking Workshop on April 22 and 23 at the mall atrium, 2 pm, where little future chefs will learn the basics in cooking and baking. A minimum single receipt purchase of P1,000 should be presented on the day of the activity. On the other hand, Robinsons Place Manila will be holding its event dubbed as A Hoppy Easter at Robinsons Place Manila at the Midtown Atrium on April 16, 2 pm. It will be an afternoon of fun games, shows and amazing freebies where children will be treated to Pool of EGG-citement, Feed the Bunny, and Key Puzzle games plus, a fantastic Magic show, Balloon Twisting show, and Puppet Show. Interested participants can join by simply presenting a P2,000 single receipt purchase from Robinsons Supermarket, Robinsons Department Store, and Robinsons Appliances or a P1,000 single receipt purchase from Robinsons Place Manila mall tenants. Each receipt is equivalent to an event pass for one (1) child with a one (1) companion- and the cute part is that the event pass comes with a bunny headband and an egg basket. Robinsons Galleria-Ortigas keeps the Easter celebration cute and simple as an adorable bunny will be roaming around the mall to give away sweet treats to shoppers. For photo opportunities, there will be an enchanting photo corner at Level 2, near lower Veranda entrance. To know more about other Robinsons Malls Easter events and Summer activities, follow Robinsons Malls in Facebook: www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls; Twitter:@RobinsonsMalls; and Instagram: @RobinsonsMallsOfficial.
